bibliographic_scope.title: Nanocrystalline rhombohedral In2O3 synthesized by hydrothermal and postannealing pathways
bibliographic_scope.authors: M. Sorescu; L. Diamandescu; D. Tarabasanu-Mihaila; V. S. Teodorescu

interpretations.text: Hydrothermal processing first produces orthorhombic InOOH. Annealing at 500 °C for 1 h in normal atmosphere gives rhombohedral In2O3. Separate records preserve the intermediate and final phases with explicit parent-record lineage; these are stages of two vessel routes, not four unrelated physical batches.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental synthesis; Figure 1 and second-vessel comparison

interpretations.topic: Two vessels with different reported detail
interpretations.text: The first experiment uses a stirred 300 mL stainless-steel pressure vessel, 0.7 M aqueous indium nitrate monohydrate, 200 °C and 4 h. The second uses a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave without stirring. The source calls its filtration, washing and drying similar to the first case; its hydrothermal concentration, temperature and dwell are not independently restated. Vessel capacities do not establish liquid charges.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1, Experimental synthesis paragraph

interpretations.topic: Reference cells are not specimen refinements
interpretations.text: For orthorhombic InOOH, cited reference values are a = 5.260 Å, b = 4.560 Å and c = 3.270 Å; the first hydrothermal specimen refines to 5.262, 4.591 and 3.258 Å. For rhombohedral In2O3, reference a = 5.487 Å and c = 14.510 Å differ from the first annealed specimen values 5.469 and 14.491 Å. Only the refined specimen values enter product measurements. No atomic coordinates are supplied.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1, XRD phase indexing and lattice refinements

interpretations.topic: XRD sizes and TEM have distinct evidence
interpretations.text: The annealed stainless-steel route has a Scherrer mean of 12 nm and reported range 10–18 nm. The continuing XRD comparison gives a mean of 22 nm and range 19–26 nm for the annealed Teflon-lined route. These are author-reported size estimates, not newly counted TEM distributions. Figure 2a qualitatively confirms nanometer particles only for the stainless-steel route; its 100 nm scale bar is not a particle diameter.

evidence.locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Scherrer estimate, second-vessel comparison and Figure 2

interpretations.topic: Stirring is an interpretation, not an isolated causal test
interpretations.text: The authors attribute the size difference to stirring effects. The experiments also use different vessel capacities and liner materials, and not every second-experiment condition is restated. The attribution is retained as the authors’ interpretation without treating it as a controlled one-variable law.

Figure 1b indexes rhombohedral In2O3, R-3c (167), ASTM 22-336. The authors report no detectable XRD peaks from other indium compounds; this does not establish an absolute chemical-purity limit. Figure 2b supports rhombohedral diffraction for the first annealed specimen. Introductory conductivity and sensing claims refer to background literature, not measurements on these powders.

limitations: Complete three-page supplied main only; SI not located or verified, cited full sources unreviewed.

Actual solution volume, indium nitrate mass, filling fraction, stirring speed, heating/cooling ramps, reaction pressure, filter specification, wash volume/repetitions and storage are unreported. Vessel capacity is not a liquid charge.

The second experiment states a 50 mL Teflon-lined autoclave without a stirrer and similar filtration/washing/drying. Its hydrothermal temperature, dwell and concentration are not separately restated; these remain unknown instead of silently inheriting the first experiment.

The refined lattice constants belong to the first stainless-steel experiment. Reference lattice constants are context, not measured product values. Figure 2 TEM/SAED belongs only to its annealed product.

XRD/Scherrer size estimates remain separate from qualitative TEM morphology. No particle coordinates, microscopy counting statistics, measured conductivity or other introductory application property is supplied.
